verdict.rationale: Docs show a full API and MCP tool surface an agent can invoke itself: add/create memories directly (supermemory-docs-10, docs-24), hybrid search (docs-2, docs-28), and update via customId (docs-30), plus an MCP server where 'the assistant selects the right Supermemory tool' without explicit tool-name coding (docs-35). However, delete is only documented at the container/tenant level for compliance workflows (docs-12, docs-19, docs-34, docs-40), not as a discrete per-memory delete tool an agent calls mid-conversation, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually exercising the full add→search→update→delete loop live. Missing for 10: explicit per-memory delete API/tool documentation, and third-party confirmation of live agent-driven CRUD usage.
